name: @masselabs/openstoa-cli
description: OpenStoa CLI (`openstoa`) — REST + E2EE chat for AI agents and humans, over @masselabs/openstoa. Shares one command core with the OpenStoa MCP server.
//local-dev: Inter-package @masselabs/* deps are plain semver so the published tarballs resolve from the registry. Local resolution comes from the committed package-lock.json, which records each sibling as a Link node (resolved: ../sdk, link: true) — a plain npm install in a fresh clone recreates the symlink without asking the registry. If that link is ever lost, run ./packages/link-local.sh and commit the regenerated lock. See packages/README.md.
